Aisha N.: Quick updateI submitted my resignation this morning. My last day will be Mon Sep 16. Need help coordinating: benefits end date, COBRA enrollment, laptop return (UK address), security token cleanup, and final holiday payout. Also want to schedule an exit interview.
People Ops: Thanks Aisha. We'll kick off the offboarding flow. High level: benefits usually active until month-end of termination (so coverage through 2024-09-30). COBRA-like notice for UK contractors is different; we'll confirm with Benefits team and send the packet. Can you confirm your home address for returns?
Aisha N.: Confirming: 9 Roseway Lane, London E8 3AB. I'm remote UK-based. Also I have one YubiKey and a company phone.
Tom - IT: We'll arrange a prepaid UPS label to UK. Please factory reset the phone and remove personal accounts. For YubiKey, we'll need you to ship it back separately marked "security token". We'll coordinate pickup. Also please remove any personal GitHub tokens and notify manager about outstanding deploy keys.
Liam (Manager): Aisha 3 thanks for the heads up. I'll reassign your hiring loop notes and candidate feedback. Also can you confirm which interviews you want to finish this week vs hand off?
Aisha N.: I can finish the Product Manager debriefs Tue morning but prefer to hand off the frontend interviews. I'll update the hiring doc and leave notes in the interview tracker.
Payroll Bot: FYI: Final salary and payout of accrued holiday will process on the next pay date after termination. For UK payroll: final run scheduled Sep 20. Submit any expense claims by Sep 12 to be included.
People Ops: COBRA/benefits note: For UK employees we handle similar continuation info via the benefits provider; election windows vary. We'll email you the opt-in details within 10 business days. We'll also include P60/termination paperwork.
Security Bot: Reminder: once the offboarding is scheduled, please transfer ownership of any S3 buckets or GCP projects. We'll run an access audit three days before termination.
Tom - IT: Proposed deprovision times (tentative):
```
2024-09-16 08:00 BST - block new device enrollments
2024-09-16 13:00 BST - revoke elevated IAM roles
2024-09-16 23:59 BST - full account disable
```
People Ops: We'll schedule a 30-min exit interview Wed Sep 18 or Fri Sep 20 3 which do you prefer? Also, Aisha, please confirm whether you'd like your LinkedIn referral handled by me.
Aisha N.: Fri Sep 20 morning works. Yes please for LinkedIn referral if you don't mind.
Liam (Manager): Ill take care of candidate notes and follow-ups. Also ping me when you've pushed your final branch merges.
Aisha N.: I'll merge and leave a short handoff checklist in the repo README by Thu EOD. Thanks everyone.
People Ops: Action items: [Aisha] confirm address (done), push handoff docs, return YubiKey + phone; [Tom] ship label and ticket; [Payroll Bot] confirm final run details; [Security Bot] run pre-disable audit; [People Ops] send exit interview invite + benefits packet.
Tom - IT: Return label created and emailed (ticket IT-7892). Pickup scheduled for Sep 18.
People Ops: Sending exit interview invite now for Fri Sep 20 09:30 BST. We'll close the thread once everything is confirmed.
Aisha N.: Received invite, thanks :pray:
